notes.title: 🚨 BIG UPDATE: New Visuals, NPCs, Animations, and Puzzles! 🎉
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We're thrilled to bring you a major update for Back To The Collis!

 Over the past few months, we’ve been hard at work making some exciting improvements and additions that we can’t wait to share with you. Here’s what’s new:

🔹 Complete Visual upgrade
The world of Back To The Collis just got a stunning upgrade! We’ve fine-tuned every environment and atmospheric details to immerse you even more deeply into Benjamin’s journey.

🔹 More NPCs and Interactions
We've added new NPCs to make the world feel even more alive. You’ll encounter new characters with their stories.

🔹 New Animations
The characters in Back To The Collis now move more smoothly and  than ever before. We’ve renewed and added animations to bring more life to every interaction.

🔹 Puzzles 
We've added even more puzzles to challenge you as you explore the game world. 


Keep your eyes peeled, we can’t wait to show you the results of our hard work!
 👀

Updated Announcement Trailer Coming Soon!


🎮 And, Demo Available Very Soon!
 A playable demo is just around the corner, giving you a first-hand experience of all the improvements. 

Stay tuned for more info and the official demo release date.



See you soon in Collis! 🌲🦋




 Back To The Collis Team
